_l9_canonical.grading_notes: Safe leverage L is the maximum total exposure factor where post-shock LTV remains within the 95% E-mode max LTV after a combined 5.5% collateral value reduction. Solve (L - 1) / (0.945 * L) <= 0.95, so 0.10225L <= 1 and L <= 9.78x. Carry and gas do not alter the leverage answer.
